depth_justification: Genuinely engages PulseTrack's specifics (PPG motion artifacts, sensor/algorithm drift, Class IIa app-as-presentation-layer, Swiss DPA) but is badly undermined by heavy verbatim looping (Reflection Questions 10/13 and 11/14 are duplicates) and never tackles the salient GP/DEP/Sécurité-Sociale cross-border data-sharing risk it kept naming.
actionability_justification: Delivers the requested severity-grouped report with several concrete, implementable steps (error-rate metrics in the CER, out-of-range warning thresholds, logged monthly recalibration with reference benchmarks, AES-256 at rest) plus an explicit not-covered list, though a few items stay directional and a couple of citations are loose.
salient_examples: 'Implement a warning system for users when BP estimates fall outside a predefined clinical threshold'
'Include error rate metrics (e.g., sensitivity, specificity, mean absolute error) in the clinical study'
Reflection Question 13 is a verbatim copy of Reflection Question 10 (same body, same citations)
GDPR Article 30 cited as the reference for encryption-at-rest (imprecise mapping)
